findings.finding: Canonical V14 can accept an arbitrary/empty reentry payload, report trace OK, and treat REENTERED as recovery COMPLETE without an explicit terminal DONE receipt or exact causal support binding.

The active candidate-only V17 lane now storage-binds reentry to the exact V14 effect attempt and verified outcome and blocks legacy unbound reentry; target-VPS differential receipt remains required before promotion.

The active V17 candidate still accepts episode_id/signal_id/causal_id/admitted_delta_hash as non-empty symbols without proving they resolve to canonical GWT use, causal credit, admitted state, or the current V15/V16 self.root execution epoch. A negative discriminator was committed to the target repository and routed to the accepted self-hosted Ubuntu VPS.

U10 architecture requires execution_id/lease_epoch fencing and provenance-bound reentry, but U10_EPOCH_VERSIONED_STATE_CANDIDATE.sql currently leaves u10_tx_commits.execution_id/lease_epoch nullable and models u10_reentry_receipts episode/signal/causal/outcome/credit/delta references as unconstrained TEXT. Therefore U10 does not yet enforce its own causal/execution invariants at the storage boundary.

Existing accepted-Hostinger mechanism evidence favors logical unification plus epoch-guarded derived projections: single-file paired commit p50 was lower, while guarded split-file steady reads were near parity; unguarded split snapshots were incoherent. This does not justify physical graph/vector/tensor consolidation yet.

required_u10_changes_before_promotion: Make execution binding explicit and fail-closed for authoritative execution/effect commits: exact current execution_id plus V15/V16 lease_epoch fence, with stale/zombie writer rejection.

Replace or guard free-form reentry support symbols with canonical verified references/receipts for WorkspaceEpisode or attention identity, receiver causal use/local effect, verified outcome, causal credit, and admitted semantic delta; retain an explicitly typed no-learning path when appropriate.
Make terminal DONE a distinct durable semantic receipt whose validity depends on the exact verified effect attempt/outcome, exact canonical reentry binding, and accepted execution epoch.
Keep all V17/U10 changes additive and candidate-only until exact-source target-VPS crash/restart/concurrency/recovery/resource gates pass.
do_not_promote: Do not infer causal provenance from non-empty identifiers.
Do not infer current self.root ownership merely because a verified provider outcome exists.
Do not merge ClayGraph/vector/tensor physical storage merely to remove an epoch guard that is already cheap in steady reads.

next_falsifier: On the accepted Ubuntu VPS, demonstrate that a candidate rejects fabricated GWT/causal/delta support and any effect completion from IDLE/stale/unbound execution epochs, while accepting a fully bound exact effect -> verified outcome -> causal-use -> admitted-delta -> reentry -> DONE chain across restart.
research_consequence: NO U10/V17 promotion claim. F-V01-04 remains OPEN; this delta strengthens the causal/execution acceptance gate and is now shared with the persistent Clay research state.
